[[Darth Baras]] owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|single-bladed]] '''lightsaber''' during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the Great Galactic War, at some point prior to [[3664 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xerender]] engaged the Sith Lord Darth Baras in a [[Duel against Darth Baras|duel]]. Xerender was joined in his fight by his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]], who attempted to sway Baras to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. The Jedi failed in this task, and although Baras escaped, Wyellett managed to steal the Sith Lord's lightsaber and use it in conjunction with his own.

In [[3642 BBY]], Baras would send his apprentice, the [[Empire's Wrath|future]] [[Emperor's Wrath]], to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to search for a weapon that turned out to be Wyelett, using his connection with the force to locate the lightsaber. It was retrieved before it could be sold to a pack of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] scavengers.
